subject: Deployment mode & pricing — Acme Health
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Reynolds <sophie.reynolds@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-22T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Deployment mode & pricing — Acme Health

Hi Sophie — great to meet you today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we have alignment before I build a detailed cost model: 

What we heard from you:
- Primary drivers: predictable latency for clinician-facing features (95th %ile < 150ms), strict data isolation for PHI, and predictable monthly cost for budgeting.
- Workload: ~50k inference requests/day today, expected to grow to 200k in 12 months; average request length ~120 tokens, occasional long-context sessions for chart summarization.
- Security asks: customer-managed KMS, audit logs retention for 7 years, SOC 2 evidence.

Deployment modes you're considering:
1) Hosted API — fastest to go live, per-token billing, good for pilot and bursty traffic.
2) Dedicated capacity — reserved GPU pools (monthly commits) for predictable throughput and lower unit cost at scale.
3) Private (VPC / on-prem) — full network isolation, required for PHI in some of your clinics.

Next steps / asks (I can turn these into a scoped cost model):
- Confirm target go-live and expected steady-state QPS for months 1, 3, 12.
- Tell us which environments must be within VPC/on-prem vs which can use Hosted initially.
- Any contractual constraints (vendor procurement timelines, security questionnaire deadlines)?

I've attached a preliminary deployment-cost-comparison.xlsx that includes ballpark per-token hosted rates, reserved commit examples, and a sample Dedicated capacity configuration. Also attaching Redwood SOC 2 summary (redwood-sla-soc2.pdf).

If that looks right, I can put together three scenarios (pilot on Hosted; mid-stage on Dedicated with burst to Hosted; and full Private deployment) with TCO for 12 months and recommended commit levels. Would love to schedule a follow-up next week with your procurement/security folks and our Solutions Engineer.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: deployment-cost-comparison.xlsx, redwood-sla-soc2.pdf

From: Sophie Reynolds <sophie.reynolds@acmehealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deployment mode & pricing — Acme Health

Thanks Aditya — this is helpful and matches our notes. A few clarifications from our side before you model out dollar amounts:

- We are most interested in Dedicated capacity for production (for latency and predictability) but need Private (VPC) for the clinics that handle PHI. Pilot workloads (some non-PHI features) can run on Hosted to move faster.
- Can you give ballpark numbers for: 
  a) Hosted per-token (generation) cost at low/high usage tiers, and any egress/network fees we should expect?
  b) Dedicated reserved monthly commit examples — e.g., what does a 1x, 4x, 8x GPU pool translate to in QPS and cost?
  c) Typical discount for annual commit vs month-to-month?
- Security: our InfoSec will need confirmation of KMS integration and proof of audit log retention. SOC 2 summary is a good start; will need more detail during procurement.
- Timeline: procurement typically needs 6–8 weeks for enterprise contracts; would like to align the technical kickoff in that window.

Can we do a 30-min follow-up on Tue 3/24 or Wed 3/25? Please include your Solutions Engineer and any SRE/arch who can speak to Dedicated sizing.

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Reynolds
Senior Product Manager, Data & AI | Acme Health
Sophie.Reynolds@acmehealth.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Reynolds <sophie.reynolds@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-22T17:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deployment mode & pricing — Acme Health

Sophie — thanks for the clear asks. Below are ballpark numbers / assumptions I used (I will produce a detailed spreadsheet scenario per your QPS growth next):

Assumptions:
- Average generation length: 120 tokens; average model throughput equivalent to a modern open LLM we benchmarked.
- Peak concurrency and KV-cache hit patterns ignored for now (we'll add after sizing call).

Scenario-level ballparks (net of standard PLG credits but pre-negotiated enterprise discounts):
1) Hosted API (per-token):
   - Gen requests: $0.0009 / 1k output tokens (example tier); embedding ops separately — included in sheet.
   - For 50k requests/day @120 tokens = ~6M tokens/day => ~180M tokens/month => ~$162/month at this per-token rate (note: this is illustrative; real per-token varies by model & throughput).
2) Dedicated capacity (reserved monthly commit):
   - Example commit levels: 1x (reserved 1 A100-equivalent pod) => ~200 QPS for short requests (very approximate), 4x => 800 QPS, 8x => 1600 QPS.
   - Monthly commit pricing (ballpark): 1x = $18k/mo, 4x = $68k/mo, 8x = $125k/mo. These include reserved GPU capacity + base support.
   - Effective per-inference cost drops significantly at higher commits; I'll compute cost/token in the spreadsheet for your expected mix.
3) Private / VPC (managed private control plane):
   - Includes one-time setup fee for VPC peering & KMS config (~$15k) and higher baseline for network isolation. Ongoing infra-cost similar to Dedicated plus support/ops surcharge.

Discounting example:
- Annual commit typically gets 10–25% depending on commit size and term. I'll create two price decks: 12-mo and 36-mo with illustrative discounts.

Next steps I propose:
- I'll circulate a 3-scenario cost sheet (Pilot on Hosted; Dedicated + Hosted burst; Private full isolation) by EOD Monday (3/23).
- Schedule a 30-min sizing call Tue 3/24 11:00am PT with our Solutions Engineer (Marissa) and SRE (Vivek). Does that work?

If you want, I can also include a worked example that maps your 50k -> 200k growth to committed levels and shows breakeven (Hosted vs Dedicated) at various months.

Thanks — Aditya

Attachments: deployment-cost-comparison.xlsx, SOW-draft.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sophie Reynolds <sophie.reynolds@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-03-23T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deployment mode & pricing — Acme Health

Looping in a quick sizing and discount proposal from infra side. Internal note first then shared summary for Sophie below.

Internal: for Acme's stated growth curve (50k -> 200k/day), 4x Dedicated looks like the right starting point if they want sub-150ms P95 and predictable cost. If they commit annual, we can offer a 15% discount on the 4x list price and include a runbook for KMS + audit logs. Private (VPC) will add a one-time setup and modest monthly ops surcharge (~10% of commit).

Shared (for Sophie):
Sophie — quick follow-up with an operational recommendation:
- Recommended pilot: Hosted for non-PHI features for 4–6 weeks while we stand up a 4x Dedicated pool for production traffic to keep latency predictable.
- Pricing: if Acme signs a 12-month commit for the 4x pool, we can target an effective 15% discount off the $68k/mo list price (so ~$57.8k/mo). That would generally reach parity with Hosted per-inference costs in month 2–3 for your expected growth (I will show the breakeven chart in the spreadsheet).
- Security: we can enable customer-managed KMS and 7-year audit retention; I'll coordinate with Marissa to provide the detailed SOC 2 artifact pack and a runbook for KMS integration.

I'm happy to join the sizing call Tue 3/24 11am PT.

— Vivek
